name: gen-edit-noctq
then: (() => { const sel=document.querySelector('.w-model select'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(sel,'NoctQ-V4'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); const ta=document.querySelector('.gen-comp textarea'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(ta,'put a red knitted scarf on the fox, leave the snow and the pose alone'); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'prompt=' + JSON.stringify(ta.value.slice(0,24)) })()

name: gen-edit-attach
then: (() => { const png=(w,h,fn)=>{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const g=c.getContext('2d');fn(g,w,h);const b=atob(c.toDataURL('image/png').split(',')[1]);const u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return u}; const fox=(g,w,h)=>{const s=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);s.addColorStop(0,'#1b2b45');s.addColorStop(1,'#8fb3c9');g.fillStyle=s;g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);g.fillStyle='#e8eef4';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,h);g.lineTo(w*.35,h*.55);g.lineTo(w*.7,h);g.closePath();g.fill();g.fillStyle='#d1631f';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(w*.55,h*.68,w*.19,h*.13,0,0,7);g.fill();g.beginPath();g.arc(w*.68,h*.52,w*.07,0,7);g.fill()}; const msk=(g,w,h)=>{g.fillStyle='#000';g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);g.fillStyle='#fff';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(w*.55,h*.52,w*.2,h*.12,0,0,7);g.fill()}; const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([png(640,480,fox)],'fox.png',{type:'image/png'})); const i=document.querySelector('.srcs input[multiple]'); i.files=dt.files; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok' })()

name: gen-edit-mask
then: (() => { const png=(w,h,fn)=>{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;const g=c.getContext('2d');fn(g,w,h);const b=atob(c.toDataURL('image/png').split(',')[1]);const u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);return u}; const msk=(g,w,h)=>{g.fillStyle='#000';g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);g.fillStyle='#fff';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(w*.55,h*.52,w*.2,h*.12,0,0,7);g.fill()}; const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([png(640,480,msk)],'scarf-mask.png',{type:'image/png'})); const i=document.querySelectorAll('.srcs input[type=file]')[1]; i.files=dt.files; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok' })()
